metadata.title: WeberslinkClip | Turn long videos into short clips
metadata.description: Upload or paste a long video and get captioned vertical clips for YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Reels. The AI picks the best moments, crops to 9:16 and syncs captions word by word.
metadata.openGraphDescription: Turn long videos into captioned vertical clips for Shorts, TikTok and Reels. Free during early bird.
metadata.twitterDescription: AI clip selection, word-synced captions and 9:16 crops. Free during early bird.

structured.software: An AI video clipper that finds the best moments in a long video, crops them to vertical, adds word-synced captions and exports short-form clips.
structured.featureExports: Exports for YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Instagram Reels
structured.website: Turn long videos into short clips.

footer.tagline: Turn long videos into short clips.

hero.badge: Early bird: free while we're in early access
hero.body: Paste a link or upload a long video. WeberslinkClip finds the moments worth posting, crops them to vertical and adds captions that follow every word.
hero.note: No card needed for the early bird plan.

steps.title: From long video to ready clips in three steps

drop.title: Add your video
drop.description: Paste a YouTube, Twitch or Kick link, or upload your own file.

gold.title: We find the moments
gold.description: The transcript is read word by word and the strongest stretches are picked and scored.

export.title: Edit, download or post
export.description: Adjust anything in the editor, then download the clip or send it to YouTube, TikTok or Instagram.

features.title: Everything between the recording and the post
features.body: Each step is handled for you, and every clip stays editable.

find.title: Clip selection
find.description: The AI reads the transcript and picks the moments that stand on their own, each with a score.

crop.title: Vertical framing
crop.description: Face detection keeps the speaker centered in a 9:16 frame.

captions.title: Word-synced captions
captions.description: Captions follow the speech word by word. Pick a style, a font and a size.

hook.title: Hook titles
hook.description: A short headline over the first seconds of each clip, written for you and editable.

editor.title: Built-in editor
editor.description: Trim, split and merge clips, fix a word, restyle captions and reframe.

export.title: Export and publish
export.description: Download for TikTok, Reels or Shorts, or connect your accounts and post from the task page.

pricing.title: Free to start. Simple plans after that.
pricing.body: Early bird access is free. Paid plans are month-to-month and you can cancel any time.

earlyBird.name: Early bird
earlyBird.description: Everything you need to turn long videos into clips, at no cost while we're in early access.

pro.description: For a steady flow of clips every month.

scale.description: For teams posting clips every day.

pricing.exports: Download your clips in TikTok, Reels and Shorts formats
pricing.note: Prices in US dollars. Plans renew monthly and you can cancel from settings.

cta.title: Your next video is already a week of content.
cta.body: Create a free account and clip your first video in minutes.
